sources.title: What Is Qwen? Alibaba's Open-Source AI Explained (2026)
sources.snippet: Qwen is Alibaba's AI family and the world's most popular open-weight model — Apache-2.0, multilingual, free to self-host. What it is, its models, and how it compares to Doubao.

sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an AI assistant for everyone, powered by the Qwen series models. It's free to use, open to all, and ready to help with creativity, collaboration, and endless possibilities.

sources.title: Alibaba AI models hit 3 billion downloads, passing Meta, Google
sources.snippet: Qwen, Alibaba's family of AI models, has open-sourced more than 460 models and its ecosystem has spawned 300,000-plus derivatives.
